description: Gulls by day: a long call of a few notes, harmonic, its first peak near 1.2 kHz and falling at each note's end (the long calls of large gulls, gull-research.org; Mierauskas and Greimas, 1992), a few a minute, from a point off the shore. A note lasts note seconds, notes notes a call; the band's centre is the call's pitch. Heard within reach metres of a town.
